name: echoverse-desktop
description: EchoVerse desktop voice and chat app

scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.release:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish always
scripts.release:mac:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.release:mac:intel: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: EchoVerse sesli konuşma için mikrofonunu kullanır.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: EchoVerse görüntülü konuşma için kameranı kullanır.
